messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Blue Ridge Recruiting <amy@blueridge.io>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GTM sprint seeding: accelerated offer path for SDR/SE hires

Team —

We have a narrow window to seed a 6-week GTM sprint (East/West quota territories) that requires us to add 6 ICs immediately: 3 SDRs (IC1-IC2) and 3 Solutions Engineers (SE L1-L2). Hiring momentum from pipeline and a few late-stage candidates (via Blue Ridge) means we can close faster if we approve an "accelerated offer path" for this batch.

High-level ask:
- Approve 6 headcount slots now (2 SDR hires to be final offers, 1 SDR conditional hold), 3 SE slots.
- Approve compensation bands for this sprint cohort (below).
- Authorize use of accelerated interview protocol (2-round loop + fast reference + conditional background) and triaged recruiter offer authority (Amy @ Blue Ridge) to fast-follow once approvals are in.

Comp bands (proposed) — total OTE/year (US):
- SDR IC1: Base 55k / OTE 110k
- SDR IC2 (senior): Base 70k / OTE 140k
- SE L1: Base 95k / OTE N/A (role is salaried)
- SE L2: Base 120k / OTE 160k

Justification:
- Sprint is tied to a pent-up demand pilot (north of $1.8M ARR pipeline) and we expect 2x ROI on hires within 6 months if seeded on time.
- Market signals: our comp bands are competitive against immediate comps for SDR/SE in SF/NY.

Risks & mitigations:
- Speed may reduce candidate evaluation depth — mitigation: keep hiring bar checklist and require at least one live technical demo for SEs; RBAC for conditional offers (background & reference check gating).
- Budget: will land under Q2 hiring commit; I propose charging to GTM-Sprint-2027 cost center (code: 4-GTM-77).

Attachments: headcount spreadsheet and playbook (short). Link to hiring doc: https://redwood.gdrive/company/hiring/sprint-seeding-2027

Next steps I need from you today:
1) Ben — approve headcount + bands so we can start offers by EOD tomorrow.
2) Priyom — confirm HR ok on accelerated protocol and background gating.
3) Marissa — confirm interview panel and offer language finalization.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick sync if helpful.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Field Programs, GTM Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Blue Ridge Recruiting <amy@blueridge.io>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GTM sprint seeding: accelerated offer path for SDR/SE hires

Thanks Sofia — strong rationale. A few quick clarifications before I sign off: 

1) For SDR IC1 vs IC2, can we lock authority so that Amy can extend offers up to the IC2 band without a separate exec sign-off (as long as candidates meet the panel checklist)?
2) For SEs, confirm that SE L1 will be on the standard IC career ladder (no commission), and L2 will be on a blended comp with discretionary bonus — we should reflect that in offer language.
3) If we do 3 SEs, do you have preferred territories/teams to place them on day 1 to avoid single-team saturation?

I agree with conditional background gating. Also suggest adding a clause in the playbook for immediate onboarding seats to be reserved for sprint hires so we don't over-allocate ramp resources.

If Ben is good with delegation to Amy for SDR bands (within limits), I'm comfortable moving forward.

—Marissa
Director, GTM Talent Ops
Redwood Inference
